instruction: Remove Ideal Loads In Four-Space Init Model This task starts from Desktop input files: init.osm, weather.epw. Reference image is provided on the Desktop: init_plan.png. Modify the OpenStudio model as needed and save the required output as result.osm. 1. The output folder contains result.osm with size at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. Result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 4 OS:Space objects, and 4 OS:ThermalZone objects. 4. The OS:Space names are exactly V13-Space-1, V13-Space-2, V13-Space-3, and V13-Space-4. 5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 6. The model has exactly 24 OS:Surface objects: 4 Floor surfaces, 4 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 16 Wall surfaces. 7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 4 Ground, 14 Outdoors, and 6 Surface. 8. The model has exactly 8 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 8. 9. The model contains exactly 0 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 4 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 4 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects. 10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 28.00 m, Y span 9.00 m, and Z span 3.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 11. The sum of floor surface areas is 252.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 236.80 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 13. The total fixed-window area is 35.84 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
